Scope: Target workshop balance supplied by caller, unchanged; zero starter structures. Public commands only; default four blueprints. Compact mixed battery inside a repaired pencil wall ring. After spawning ends, a small enemy tail or an entirely ranged tail receives paid pursuit guns only for spitters outside every existing tower's range. Pursuit construction takes priority over recurring wall repairs. The blue point is initially exposed until actual enemy destruction, then recaptured only after fourteen base towers and a fully funded wall ring plus four dual-gun defenders. Additional towers use finite earned ink. One manual cleanup demonstrates the tool; blue cartridges use earned well payouts. Every wave launches immediately. WaveInkGrant is only the historical fallback; each WaveTuning/Waves InkGrant resolves its ConfiguredInkGrant. This strategy chooses no Salvage reward multiplier. Fixed-step headless evidence; not a frame-time benchmark.
